title: Script operand validation
summary: Recover the signed operand checks at VA 0x486180, including the flagged limit selection and default acceptance.
test_description: Compare original and recovered results across types, signed operand and limit boundaries, flag transitions, and byte limits; verify every context byte remains unchanged.
known_limits: Original field names and broader script semantics are unresolved.
Original uses a custom ECX/EDX/stack calling convention; the portable member method does not reproduce that binary ABI.
Invalid object pointers and concurrent mutation are not tested.
